map.矩阵乘法要求前者的列数等于后者的行数，结果维度为「前者的行 × 后者的列」。常见: Matrix multiplication requires the number of columns in the first matrix to equal the number of rows in the second, and the result has the dimensions (rows of the first) × (columns of the second). A common mistake is reversing the order — A(2×3) times B(3×4) is valid and yields 2×4, but B times A is simply invalid. Even when both are square, swapping the order usually changes the result.
